/api/data/distVillage: Method: GET. Payload: Query param: tehsil (long, required). Description: Returns Villages belonging to a given Tehsil.
/api/data/fetchDistReport: Method: GET. Payload: Query params: topicId (String, optional), version (String, optional). Description: Returns the district internal report(s) for a topic, optionally filtered by version.
/api/data/getAllTopics: Method: GET. Payload: Query params: page (int, default 0), size (int, default 100), search, topicId, district, zone, broadCategory, subCategory, ticketStatus, internalReportStatus, reportUploaded (all String, optional), sort (String, default "high"), startDate/endDate (LocalDate ISO, optional), startDateTime/endDateTime (LocalDateTime ISO, optional), dateFilterType (String, default "created"), keywordQuery (String, optional), minPostCount (Integer, optional). Description: The main topics-listing endpoint with extensive RBAC-aware filtering, sorting, and pagination, powering the primary topic/dashboard tables.
/api/data/analyzedDataByTopic: Method: GET. Payload: uniqueTopicId (String, required), readStatus (String, optional), priority (String, optional). Description: Returns posts belonging to a given topic.
/api/data/topicPostDetails: Method: GET. Payload: uniqueTopicId (String, required). Description: Returns post details and counts for a given topic.
/api/data/TopicByUniqueId: Method: GET. Payload: uniqueTopicId (String, required). Description: Returns a single topic for the given unique topic ID.
/api/data/sentimentPost: Method: GET. Payload: topicId (String, required). Description: Returns sentiment-tagged posts for a given topic.
/api/data/fetchTelephonicReport: Method: GET. Payload: topicId (String, optional). Description: Returns telephonic report data for a topic.
/api/data/saveArea: Method: POST. Payload: Body (area entity). Description: Saves an Area entry.
/api/data/distArea: Method: GET. Payload: Query param: district (Long, required). Description: Returns Areas belonging to a given district.
/api/data/hierarchy: Method: GET. Payload: No payload (derives hierarchy from request/session user). Description: Returns the police organizational hierarchy (Thana hierarchy) relevant to the requesting user.
/api/data/automateThanaMatrix: Method: POST. Payload: No payload. Description: Triggers an automated Thana Matrix generation/synchronization process.
/api/data/usertype: Method: GET. Payload: Query param: userType (String, required). Description: Returns users filtered by a given user type.
/api/data/subUsertype: Method: GET. Payload: Query param: userType (String, required). Description: Returns sub-user-type values for a given user type.
/api/data/subCategoryCounts: Method: GET. Payload: Query param: dgp (String, optional). Description: Returns unread post counts grouped by subcategory; uses HQ/DGP-specific logic when dgp flag is set.
/api/data/onClickSubCategoryData: Method: POST. Payload: Query param: subCategory (String, required). Description: Returns detailed data drill-down for a clicked subcategory (marked "Dont use this" in code comments — likely deprecated).
/api/data/fetchTopicsBasedOnKeywordCateg: Method: GET. Payload: Query params: subCategory (String, optional), uniqueTopicId (String, optional), fromDate (String, optional), toDate (String, optional). Description: Returns topics filtered by subcategory and RBAC hierarchy for the requesting user.
Method: GET. Payload: Query params: subCategory (String, required), source (String, optional). Description: Returns topics filtered by subcategory, optional source platform, and RBAC hierarchy.
/api/data/topicsBySubCategoryAndFilter: Method: GET. Payload: Query params: subCategory (String, required), columnName (String, optional), sortDirection (String, optional, default "DESC"). Description: Returns topics for a subcategory sorted by a given column/direction, used for the Topic Table filters.
/api/data/monitorProfilesAnalysis: Method: GET. Payload: No payload (RBAC derived from request). Description: Returns summary analysis details of monitored profiles.
/api/data/fetchTopicByProfileCategory: Method: GET. Payload: Query params: category (String, required), fromDate (String, optional), toDate (String, optional). Description: Returns topics grouped by profile category (RC/URC/Total posts) with per-platform counts (WhatsApp, Twitter, Facebook, Instagram, RSSFeed, GoogleAlert, GoogleNews).
/api/data/fetchDataForZoneRangeDistrictW: Method: GET. Payload: Query params: region_name (String, required), dgp (String, optional). Description: Returns zone/range/district-wise post counts, using DGP-dashboard-specific logic when dgp flag is set.
/api/data/fetchDataForRegionDetails: Method: GET. Payload: Query params: regionName (String, required), fromDate (String, optional), toDate (String, optional). Description: Returns topic details for a clicked zone/range/district/commissionerate region.
/api/data/fetchDataForRegionDetailsWithS: Method: GET. Payload: Query params: regionName (String, required), source (String, optional). Description: Returns topic details for a clicked region, filtered by source platform.
/api/data/markAsRead/{id}: Method: POST. Payload: Path variable id (Long, required); rate-limited per client IP (500 req/min bucket). Description: Marks a topic/post as read; enforces per-IP rate limiting via Bucket4j.
/api/data/markAsUnread/{id}: Method: POST. Payload: Path variable id (Long, required). Description: Marks a topic/post as unread.
/api/data/getAreaWiseComplaintsCount: Method: GET. Payload: Query param: status (String, optional). Description: Returns the count of area-wise complaints, optionally filtered by status (dashboard card).
/api/data/onClickAreaWiseComplaints: Method: GET. Payload: Query params: page (int, optional, default 0), size (int, optional, default 100), status (String, optional), fromDate (String, optional), toDate (String, optional). Description: Returns a paginated drill-down list of area-wise complaints for the dashboard card click.
/api/data/onClickComplaints: Method: GET. Payload: Query params: page (int, optional, default 0), size (int, optional, default 10000), status (String, optional), type (String, required — "area" or "keyword"), fromDate (String, optional), toDate (String, optional). Description: Unified drill-down endpoint for dashboard-card clicks on area-wise or keyword-wise complaint counts.
/api/data/getKeywordsComplaintsCount: Method: GET. Payload: Query param: status (String, optional). Description: Returns the count of keyword-based complaints, optionally filtered by status (dashboard card).
/api/data/updatePost: Method: POST. Payload: Query params: postId (List<Integer>, required), topicId (String, optional). Description: Transfers/reassigns one or more posts to a different topic; runs the update in the background and returns immediately.
/api/data/hashtags/counts: Method: GET. Payload: No payload. Description: Returns hashtag usage counts (hashtag + hashtag_count pairs).
/api/data/keywords/counts: Method: GET. Payload: No payload. Description: Returns keyword usage counts (keyword + keyword_count pairs).
/api/data/saveInternalReport: Method: POST (multipart/form-data). Payload: Form fields (all optional except noted): id (Long), district, thana, crimeNumberSection, incidentDateTime, informationDateTime, victimName, victimAge (Integer), victimCast, victimReligion, accusedTotalNumber, accusedKnown, accusedUnknown, accusedArrested, accusedRemark, incidentDescription, postmorternReport, cremationCompleted, arrestStatus, accusedVictimRelation, causeOfDeath, recoveryItem, crimeType, finalRemark, headquaterRemark, rangeRemark, zoneRemark, dgpRemark, virality, uniqueTopicId, removedPaths, fir (enum YesNoStatus), firDate, firNo, castCommunal, accusedCast, eventSummaryDelta, postmortemDelta, mediaFiles (MultipartFile[]). Description: Creates or updates a District Internal Report (detailed incident report) with optional media file attachments for a topic.
/api/data/district_internal_report_files: Method: GET. Payload: Query params: uniqueTicketId (String, required), path (String, required — image|video|pdf), index (String, required). Description: Returns the raw bytes of an attached district-internal-report file, with content-type auto-detected from the "path" type.

Method: GET. Payload: Query params: uniqueTicketId (String, required), path (String, required), version (String, required), index (String, required). Description: Returns the raw bytes of a versioned/audit-trail copy of a district-internal-report file.
/api/data/saveTelephonicReport: Method: POST. Payload: Body (TelephonicReport entity). Description: Saves a telephonic report record.
/api/data/fetchDistThana: Method: GET. Payload: Query param: district (String, required). Description: Returns the list of police stations (thanas) for a given district.
/api/data/fetchDistricts: Method: GET. Payload: No payload. Description: Returns all District entity records.
/api/data/storeIntReport: Method: POST (multipart/form-data). Payload: Form fields: uniqueTopicId (String, required), intDescription (String, required), fileTransfer (MultipartFile, optional). Description: Saves an "Int" (intelligence) description/report against a topic, with optional file attachment.
/api/data/saveCommandCenterReport: Method: POST (multipart/form-data). Payload: Form fields: uniqueTopicId (String, required), commandCenterDescription (String, required), fileTransfer (MultipartFile, optional). Description: Saves a Command Center report description against a topic, with optional file attachment.
/api/data/saveTvReport: Method: POST (multipart/form-data). Payload: Form fields: uniqueTopicId (String, required), tvScrollDescription (String, required), fileTransfer (MultipartFile, optional). Description: Saves a TV-scroll report description against a topic, with optional file attachment.
/api/data/showPdf: Method: GET. Payload: Query params: uniqueTicketId (String, required), type (String, required). Description: Streams a PDF report file (404 if not found) for a given ticket and report type.
/api/data/topicAssignDistrict/{topicId}/: Method: POST. Payload: Path variable topicId (String, required); Body (DistrictAssignRequest). Description: Assigns one or more districts to a topic that currently has no district set.
/api/data/ticketCountDashboard: Method: POST. Payload: Query params: type (String, required; CATEGORY|DISTRICT|ZONE|RANGE|BROADCATEGORY), fromDate (String, optional, format YYYY-MM-DD — date only, NO time component, e.g. "2026-09-05"), toDate (String, optional, format YYYY-MM-DD — date only, NO time component). Description: Returns Ticket Management Dashboard counts grouped by the requested dimension, plus the count of unassigned tickets.
/api/data/clickableCountConditionWise: Method: POST. Payload: Query params: condition (String, required; DISTRICT|RANGE|ZONE|SUBCATEGORY|BROADCATEGORY), district (List<String>, optional), range (String, optional), zone (String, optional), subCategory (String, optional), broadCategory (String, optional), fetchCondition (String, optional; total|progress|assigned|closed_for_verification|resolved|discarded|priority), fromDate (String, required, format YYYY-MM-DD — date only, NO time component, e.g. "2026-09-05"), toDate (String, required, format YYYY-MM-DD — date only, NO time component), search (String, optional), priority (String, optional). Description: Large multi-branch drill-down endpoint for the Ticket Management Dashboard — returns the ticket list for a clicked dashboard cell, dispatching on condition (geographic/category dimension) and fetchCondition (status bucket) combination.
/api/data/SourceOfTopic: Method: GET. Payload: Query params: uniqueTopicId (String, optional), fromDate, toDate, fromTime, toTime (String, optional), sources (List<String>, optional). Description: Returns social-media source counts and post snippets for a topic (or date range).
/api/data/fetchTopicsBySearch: Method: GET. Payload: Query params: category (String, optional), subCategory (String, optional), topicTitle (String, required). Description: Searches topics by title text, optionally scoped to a category/subcategory.
/api/data/sentimentBulk: Method: GET. Payload: Query param: topicIds (List<String>, required). Description: Returns sentiment data in bulk for multiple topic ids at once.
/api/data/sentimentPostByDateRange: Method: GET. Payload: Query params: fromDate (String, required), toDate (String, required), fromTime, toTime (String, optional), sources (List<String>, optional). Description: Returns sentiment posts for a date range with no topic filtering, used by the Trend Report page.
/api/data/AnalyseDataNew: Method: GET. Payload: Query params: topicId, fromDate, toDate, fromTime, toTime (String, optional), sources (List<String>, optional). Description: Returns a list of AnalyzedData entities matching the given topic/date/source filters.
/api/data/postUser: Method: GET. Payload: Query param: Id (Long, required). Description: Returns post-author (user) details for a given id.
/api/data/reachCount: Method: GET. Payload: Query params: topicId, fromDate, toDate, fromTime, toTime, query (String, optional), sources (List<String>, optional). Description: Returns the total social-media "reach" count for a topic/date range.
/api/data/analyzeData: Method: GET. Payload: Query params: topicId, fromDate, toDate, fromTime, toTime (String, optional), sources (List<String>, optional). Description: Returns analyzed post data filtered by topic/date/source.
/api/data/bookmarkGroups: Method: GET. Payload: Query params: userId (Long, required), search, startDate, endDate (String, optional), page (int, default 0), size (int, default 10). Description: Returns a paginated, searchable list of a user's bookmark groups.
/api/data/saveBookmarkGroup: Method: POST. Payload: Body (Bookmark entity). Description: Creates a new bookmark group.
/api/data/saveArchivalGroup: Method: POST. Payload: Body (Archive entity). Description: Creates a new archival group.
/api/data/addPostToBookmarks: Method: POST. Payload: Query params: postId (Long, required), bookmarkIds (String, required — comma-separated ids), analyzeId (Long, optional), type (String, required — "ANALYZED" or "POST"). Description: Adds a post (or analyzed-data record) to one or more bookmark groups.
/api/data/commonAttachment: Method: GET. Payload: Query param: Id (List<Long>, required). Description: Returns common attachment metadata/bytes for the given list of ids.
